mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 5% signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the federal funds rate does not decline below 5% or S&P 500 forward returns are not positive over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4% indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the unemployment rate does not exceed 4.1% or S&P 500 returns are not negative over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 4% and GDP demand (GDPC1) exceeds 23,000 billion chained 2017 dollars, the combination signals accommodative policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the interaction of FEDFUNDS <4% and GDPC1 >23000 does not occur or returns are not positive over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime where CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 2% but FEDFUNDS remains below 2%, persistent monetary accommodation fuels equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the regime conditions (CPIAUCSL >2% AND FEDFUNDS <2%) are not met or returns are not positive over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in employment (PAYEMS) and production (INDPRO) above their 50-week moving averages signal a strengthening labor-supply cycle, boosting corporate profits and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If either PAYEMS or INDPRO does not exceed their 50-week moving averages or returns are not positive over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A one-time surge in GDP demand (GDPC1) exceeding 23,000 billion chained 2017 dollars triggers a short-term equity rally, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 does not cross above 23000 or returns are not positive over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, signaling labor market recovery, it reduces risk premiums and enhances equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not fall below 3.5% or returns are not positive over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the production index (INDPRO) above 102.33 suggests a robust supply-side expansion, lowering inflationary pressures and supporting equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not sustainably increase above 102.33 over the 60-day horizon or S&P 500 returns are not positive.
